VC-62.counter_reading: src/sqllens/safety/rls.py:332 returns tree.sql(dialect=dialect) whenever rules are configured, so the SQL the runners check and execute is sqlglot's re-render, and sqlglot 30.26.0 parses SELECT U&"\0066oo"() FROM orders as BitwiseAnd(Column U, Anonymous "\0066oo") and re-renders it as SELECT U & "\0066OO"() FROM orders, whose spaced "U &" PostgreSQL does not read as a Unicode-escape identifier prefix, so the executed statement calls a function literally named \0066OO, not foo.
